ence/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) us
es MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` r
oute (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md):
Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately: the proxy fails a revoked lease closed
from that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather th
an something a caller must do.\n- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-inge
stion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.\n- [Appe
nd iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one ba
tch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.\n- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an e
val. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no
debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n- [Open a run for increme
ntal ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.md): Opens a run that iterati
ons are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and `runs/finalize`.\n- [Get a run's g
ate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-gate-waiver.md): The waiver in force over this run, or `nul
l`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not only to those who can grant one: a waiver its readers cannot see is not a visibl
e waiver.\n- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/waive-a-run-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's rel
ease gate until an expiry you name. This does NOT make the run pass: the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited
record, and every surface that honors it, such as the CLI's `eval gate`, reports the gate as waived, by whom, why, and until when.
\n- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-gate-waiver.md): End a waiver early, putting t
he gate back. Requires the manage tier.\n- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.co
m/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-deterministic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permiss
ion and a terminal run. Reserves a 60-second deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned co
ntinuation object with the unchanged draft to read the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second op
erat…\n- [Get the host-compat catalog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-host-compat-catalog.md): The versione
d host-compatibility catalog backing `mcpjam compat` verdicts. Public and unauthenticated: static host facts and creation config w
ith no project or user scope. Always returns a catalog: `source` is `live` when the published catalog was reachable and `bundled`
when serving the SDK's built…\n- [Get the authenticated account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-authenticat
ed-account.md): The user behind the API key (keys act as their creator, scoped to one organization).\n- [Read the organization's s
pend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organ
ization may spend on MCPJam-billed work (chat, evals, judges and computer time) in the current billing window, and how much of it
has been spent.\n- [Set the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/set-the-organizations-spend
-budget.md): Set or replace the ceiling. **Requires organization owner or admin.**\n- [Remove the organization's spend budget](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/remove-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Leave the organization uncapped. **Requires
organization owner or admin.**\n- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The o
rganizations the caller belongs to: the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accept
s. An API key is bound to one organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes
are not part of the public API.\n- [List projects](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-projects.md): Projects the c
aller can access. API keys only ever see projects inside the key's organization.\n- [List a project's servers](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-servers.md): The MCP servers saved in the project: the `serverId`s every other route ta
kes. STDIO command/args/env and raw headers are never exposed.\n- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in the project with latest-run summaries and pass-rate trends: the `suit
eId`s the eval-run routes take.\n- [List chat sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-chat-sessions.md): Chat
sessions visible to the caller (personal + project-shared merged). Top-level rather than project-nested because `projectId` is an
optional filter, not an owning scope.\n- [The MCPJam-provided model catalog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/the-mc
pjam-provided-model-catalog.md): PUBLIC: this route carries no user or project data and requires no bearer token.\n- [Export proje
ct traces as OTLP/JSON](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/export-project-traces-as-otlpjson.md): Returns an OTLP `Expo
rtTraceServiceRequest`. Pagination rides in RESPONSE HEADERS rather than the body so the payload stays a valid OTLP document: read
`x-mcpjam-next-cursor` and feed it back as `cursor`, and treat `x-mcpjam-export-complete: true` as the end of the stream.\n- [Lis
t a project's clients](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/list-a-projects-clients.md): The clients saved in the project
: the named, reusable configurations that define how MCPJam connects to and talks to your MCP servers. Returns the `id`s and `conf
igId`s the detail and write routes take. Clients that exist only as the private backing of a User Testing study are omitted unless
`includ…\n- [Create a client (from a template or a full config)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/create-a-client-fr
om-a-template-or-a-full-config.md): Creates a client in the project and responds `201` with the new client's detail. Seed the conf
ig one of two ways: pass `template` (a built-in template id, optional `theme`) to seed server-side from the live client-template c
atalog, falling back to the bundled SDK catalog snapshot if the live catalog…\n- [Get a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/clients/get-a-client.md): One client's full settings, including its resolved config, its `configId` (the concurrency token eve
ry write takes), and `impact`: what a config edit would follow. The path segment accepts a client **name or ID**. A client that ex
ists but belongs to a different project reads as `404 NOT_FOUND`.\n- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clien
ts/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite s
till holds it: the error names what to detach first. Guest callers are denied (a write).\n- [Update a client](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/clients/update-a-client.md): Edit a client's display name and/or its config. Two ways to change the config: `con
fig` replaces it wholesale, and `set` changes named fields over the config read inside the write transaction. Prefer `set`, becaus
e a whole-config round-trip composed from a stale read reverts whatever landed in betwe…\n- [Replace a client's servers](https://d
